note: lettre de facilité du 7 février 2023 de la filiale taïwanaise avec la filiale taïwanaise de HSBC, portée de 30 M$ (7 janvier 2022) à 50 M$ ; non garantie
quote: The New Facility Letter permits borrowings up to a combined aggregate limit of $50 million which may be comprised of borrowings under a New Taiwan Dollar revolving facility with a sub-limit of NTD300 million (the "NTD Revolver") and an export/seller facility with a sub-limit of $50 million (the "Export/Seller Facility").
